normal_measurement.protocol: 5000 actual Spiral, 180 frames, three real Adds; identical production/fine flags before/after; no readback; all startup/peak frames retained; hidden WSI is not foreground certification

controls.protocol: Same baseline executable on both A/A sides; then matched 60Hz baseline/candidate. Identical flags, alternating orders, every frame retained. Hidden/unfocused WSI.

pixels.protocol: Original integrated baseline RGBA files; original native SDF and forced fine, candidate production/fine; 180 whole RGBA frames per case; no tolerance

limitations: Hidden/unfocused WSI: no foreground FPS certification.
Completed GPU submissions are delayed; sample counts and raw timestamps remain available, not per-frame GPU attribution.
Module C/C++ heap capture excludes DLL/driver heap, aligned C heap, pre-main, frees and live residency.
Production has increased means/p99/max in some cohorts. Identical-binary controls also differ; no universal speedup claim.
Alpha uses prepared native scratch; forward per-operation RGBA8 quantization is retained.
artifact_path_normalization: Windows slash aliases coalesced; artifact bytes unchanged.
